title: Quaint Crumbly Korean Rice Tteok
description: A traditional Korean dish featuring crumbly rice tteok served with a mustardy Chinese sesame sauce and bhuna, perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Preheat the salt block vessel to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the Korean rice flour and salt.
Gradually add in the water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape into tteok forms.
Place the tteok on the preheated salt block and cook for 10 minutes on each side.
While the tteok is cooking, mix the Chinese sesame sauce, bhuna spice mix, and mustard paste in a small bowl.
Brush the cooked tteok with the sesame oil and serve with the sesame sauce mixture and chopped scallions.
